My name is Ethan Present. I am a senior computer science major from Houston, Texas. I enjoy hiking, playing board/card games, and spending time with friends. I visited New York last summer, hiked in a park, and took the photo above during my visit. It reminded me of Turtle Pond here on campus.

Here is a list of a few of my favorite movies in no particular order: 

- Guardians of the Galaxy (any of them)
- Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith
- Central Intelligence 
- Transformers (any of them)
